note: Option ids are not stored here on purpose: they change every time the column list is replaced. scripts/board.sh looks them up by name at call time.
targetColumnNote: /factory-build stops at In review (PR), where CodeRabbit takes over. Approved goes to Needs merging, changes requested goes back to Ready for dev, and the third round sends the card to Stuck. Merging moves it to Needs retro, then /factory-retro moves it to Done.
